subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.**

Her son came from Europe to meet her ______ after 20 years.
solution: The correct answer is **"out of the blue."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Out of the blue"** means unexpectedly or without warning. (अप्रत्याशित रूप से या बिना किसी चेतावनी के) • **Example**: *One night, **out of the blue**__, he knocked on my door.* • This idiom is often used to describe a surprise or sudden event. • In this context, the son's visit was unexpected after 20 years of not seeing his mother. • The correct answer is option 3. **Correct sentence**: *Her son came from Europe to meet her __**out of the blue**__ after 20 years.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Blowing off the steam" **means to release anger or frustration. (क्रोध या हताशा को दूर करना) • **"Like a cakewalk" **means something is very easy to do. (कुछ करना बहुत आसान है) • **"Stepping up his game"** means to improve one's performance or effort. (किसी के प्रदर्शन या प्रयास को बेहतर बनाना) 40:Tc2b, The correct answer is** "Jewelerry."**
